(01)Profile

Mobile, engineered to last.

Senior Mobile Expert with 9+ years turning fragile codebases into production platforms. I own the full arc — domain modelling, state design, streaming pipelines, CI/CD, and the teams shipping them.

“Fast is a feature. Stable is a promise. I build for both.”

From GST logic in my first fintech app in 2016 to signed-cookie streaming engines serving 50k+ listeners today — my work lives where mobile meets hardware, media and scale. Native Android when precision matters, Flutter when reach matters, Kotlin Multiplatform when both do.
